welcome.heading: Operation Blackout
lines: You're the responder on call tonight. Ten modules, one incident, one city to bring back.
Two minutes of setup and you'll know your way around.

stops.heading: Your shift at a glance
stops.body: See which module you're on, your progress, and whether the station is live. **End** closes the lab when you finish.

stops.heading: Start every module here
stops.body: Ten modules follow the incident in order. Click **Checklist** to see what to find and which file to hand in.

stops.heading: The station, live
stops.body: Drawn from what the control room is told, so early on it may lie. **Red filled = closed, live. Green hollow = open, safe.** Click **Substation**.

stops.heading: Your desk
stops.body: Four tabs run your desk: **Mission**, **Station** (Controls, Alarms, Trends), **Evidence** (Dispatch, Frames, Timeline, Notes), and **Case & Checks**. Open **Evidence**.

stops.heading: A real shell
stops.body: A real Linux shell with real tools where most investigation happens. Click inside, type `id`, and press Enter.

stops.heading: Keep what matters
stops.body: Dashboard actions appear in **Station log**, never in your shell. **Pin** saves clues to your Timeline. Click **Station log** to peek.

stops.heading: Make the workspace yours
stops.body: Prefer the mission on the side or the terminal on the left? Drag any panel's grip handle to swap places, or pick a preset in **Layout**. Watch it swap live, then return.

stops.heading: Hand it in
stops.body: Click **Practice** for a free format check. **Submit module** grades your file; **Case & Checks** shows why. Two hints are free; the third costs 10%.

loopStripText: Objective → Investigate in the shell → Pin evidence → Write your file → Practice → Submit → Read Checks
finalLine: I'm right here in **Help** anytime you need hints, the **Glossary**, or a replay. Module 1 is waiting, and Raghav's message is in **Evidence** -> **Dispatch**.

tips.heading: Frame anatomy
tips.body: Each row is one real IEC-104 frame from the evidence. Click one to see its parts. The filter box takes `tshark` filters.

tips.heading: Split lens
tips.body: **Split lens:** the operator's screen on one side, what you've proven in the field on the other. Drag the divider.

tips.heading: Field bay check
tips.body: Devika walks to the bay you pick and reads its panel. Answers take a moment, as in the field.

tips.heading: Empty policy matrix
tips.body: Every zone pair starts empty. Nothing is filled in for you: what you set is exactly what gets applied.

tips.heading: Select before operate
tips.body: Breakers work like real ones: **Select**, check, then **Execute**. A permit asks you to confirm each close.

tips.heading: Lockout 86 and resets
tips.body: **Clear lockout 86** resets a relay after you've checked it. **Reset electrical state** starts M9 switching over cleanly. Each protection trip costs 10% (max 20%); resets themselves are free.

tips.heading: Station disconnected
tips.body: We lost the station. Practice and Submit wait until it's back. Nothing you've written is lost.

tips.heading: Case Board
tips.body: Your finding is on the Case Board. By Module 10 it tells the whole story, in your evidence.

guideItems.question: see what this module asks me to do?
guideItems.body: Read the **Mission** brief below, or click **Checklist** above the map to see the steps and the answer file to hand in.

guideItems.question: rearrange or resize the panels?
guideItems.body: Drag any panel's **⋮⋮** grip handle to swap places, pick a preset like **Mission on Left** in **Layout**, or use **Scene / Split / Terminal** (**Alt+1, 2, 3**).

guideItems.question: switch between City, Substation, and Network?
guideItems.body: Use **City**, **Substation**, and **Network** at the top of the map to switch between Suryanagar districts, switchgear bays, and network zones.

guideItems.question: read the breaker colours (Red vs Green)?
guideItems.body: **Red filled = closed, live power. Green hollow = open, isolated and safe.** Switch to **Substation** to see the full colour legend.

guideItems.question: read field reports or ask Devika for a bay check?
guideItems.body: Open **Evidence** -> **Dispatch** to read field callouts from Raghav and ask Devika Nair for a physical switchyard bay check.

guideItems.question: look inside an IEC-104 network frame?
guideItems.body: Open **Evidence** -> **IEC-104 Frames** and click any captured row to inspect its fields. The filter box accepts `tshark` filters.

guideItems.question: find a past event or scrub a trip replay?
guideItems.body: Open **Evidence** -> **Timeline** for your pinned clues, or **Station** -> **Controls** to scrub a 15-second trip replay.

guideItems.question: edit my answer file or run a free Practice check?
guideItems.body: Click **Edit file** above the terminal to edit your answer file directly, then click **Practice** at the bottom for a free format check.

guideItems.question: see why a check failed or get a hint?
guideItems.body: Open **Case & Checks** -> **Checks** to see which areas passed or failed. Progressive hints live under **Mission**; two are free and hint three costs 10%.
